exclusions.rule: Retain every failed or missing run in completeness accounting; never exclude for unfavorable outcome.
exclusions.duplicate_rule: First checksum-valid immutable attempt is primary; later attempts remain classified and preserved.

scientific_rule.CONTINUE: All GO thresholds pass and independent labels, two-arm support, and complete negative control remain valid.
scientific_rule.REVISE PROBLEM: The mechanism is distinct but an operational threshold, support condition, or controlled scenario is inadequate.
scientific_rule.NO-GO: The mechanism is not distinct, labels are circular, or the central hypothesis remains untestable after repair.
